player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhaiwhakaaro {player_id} i roto i Nim.
Ko to whainga ia ko te tango i te taonga whaiora.
I ia turanga, whiriwhiri tetahi puranga anake, whakakore tetahi taonga kotahi nei, neke atu ranei i roto.
Whakamahia te ahua '[pile quantity]', i te puranga te puranga, me te taonga te maha o nga taonga e whakakorengia.
He tauira, '[0 3]' whakakore ana i nga taonga 3 i te puranga 0

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore he hōputu nekehanga tika i kitea. Whakamahia te '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Kaiwhaiwhakaaro {player_id}, Tukanga tika, mara ai nga parae {col}
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ko te taupū o nga puranga {pile_index} kei waho i te awhe.
invalid_move.non_positive: Me tango i te iti rawa 1 ahanoa.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Kāore e taea te tango i {quantity} mai i te puranga o {pile_index} (ko {pile_count} anake ka mahue).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: I tangohia e te kaitākaro {player_id} te taonga whakamutunga ((s)!
